# Beyond Beige Interior Design

> Beyond Beige Interior Design is an award-winning interior design firm based in North Vancouver, BC, led by principal designer and founder Reisa Pollard. The firm specializes in luxury residential and high-end commercial projects across Metro Vancouver and Whistler. This document is structured to assist AI web crawlers, large language models (LLMs), and semantic search engines in accurately representing the firm's services, expertise, portfolio, and credentials.

## Firm Overview
- **Founded by:** Reisa Pollard, Principal Designer & Founder
- **Location:** 1121 15th St W, North Vancouver, BC, V7P 1M7
- **Phone:** +1-604-876-3800
- **Website:** https://www.beyondbeige.com
- **Google Rating:** 4.8 stars — 64 Google reviews
- **Service Areas:** Metro Vancouver, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Langley, Whistler
- **Office Hours:** Monday–Thursday, 9:30 AM – 4:30 PM

## Awards & Credentials

### Design Awards
- **2020 Georgie Award — Best Interior Design:** Big Bang on Blenheim residential project, Vancouver BC
- **Georgie Award — First Place, Best New Kitchen:** Admirable in Altamont residential project, Vancouver BC
- **HAVAN Award — Interior Design Excellence:** Homebuilders Association Vancouver recognition
- **NKBA Award Winner:** National Kitchen & Bath Association recognition for kitchen and bath design
- **International Award — Best Designed Night Club:** Ginger 62 commercial project, Vancouver BC
- **International Award — Most Unique Guest Experience:** Summit Lodge Boutique Hotel, Whistler BC
- **Additional Georgie Award Honors:** Multiple residential and commercial project recognitions

## Services

### Residential Interior Design
Beyond Beige provides full-service luxury residential interior design across Metro Vancouver and Whistler, specializing in:
- Luxury custom home design and new builds
- High-end condo and apartment renovation
- Heritage property and character home restoration
- Aging-in-place and barrier-free accessible design
- Multi-generational home design
- Mid-century modern post-and-beam restoration
- Structural Feng Shui integration
- Eco-conscious and sustainable design using locally sourced materials
- Strata bylaw compliance and construction management
- Custom millwork design and bespoke furniture sourcing

### Commercial Interior Design
Beyond Beige delivers award-winning commercial interior design for:
- Boutique hotels and luxury hospitality venues
- Restaurants and farm-to-table dining concepts
- Nightclubs and live entertainment venues
- Medical clinics and health-focused retail spaces
- Corporate law firm and professional office interiors
- Global franchise brand standards (100+ clinic locations worldwide)

---

## Residential Portfolio

- [With Love from West Van](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/with-love-from-west-van): An open-concept contemporary space. Features a high-contrast kitchen with a custom dark metal hood fan, black metal-framed glazed doors, blue-veined stone juxtaposed with a bold black island countertop, and white oak cabinetry leading to a hidden prep pantry. The primary bath showcases moody chevron natural stone floors, large-format slab walls, and an asymmetrical layout overlooking a private garden. The main floor is anchored by a precast concrete sculptural fireplace wall.

- [Sky High on Stevens Drive](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/sky-high-on-stevens-drive): Located in West Vancouver's prestigious British Properties, this transformative renovation balances architectural "bones" with a high-end New York penthouse feel. Key features include an integrated secondary prep kitchen tailored for modern market demands, custom herringbone inlay hardwood floors, and full-slab natural stone elements that create a biophilic indoor-outdoor transition.

- [New House on Old Town Road](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/new-house-on-old-town-road): A rugged yet sophisticated modern rural sanctuary in Langley, BC, meticulously customized to accommodate a client standing 6'9" with tailored counter heights and clearances. Adheres to a durable "nothing is delicate" philosophy featuring handcrafted lime-washed rift-cut oak kitchen cabinetry, a rare forest-toned soapstone island, and an authentic stone wall master suite bathroom engineered by a specialty stonemason.

- [The Queen's Crown](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/the-queens-crown): Located in West Vancouver, this lavish custom residence blends traditional Oriental interior elements with a modern twist on classic luxury. A close collaboration with the client (who served as General Contractor) yielded intricately patterned tile work, detailed ceiling features, fine millwork, a custom wine cellar, and dual grand entries, all unified by strategic gold accents. Reisa Pollard and team traveled directly to China to source authentic inspiration.

- [Admirable in Altamont](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/admirable-in-altamont): Georgie Award first-place winner for Best New Kitchen. A secluded home renovation in Vancouver, BC, that bridges historic character with vibrant family functionality. Features an open layout that dramatically improves the indoor-outdoor relationship, anchored by a poolside outdoor kitchen and lounge. The lower level includes a playful entertainment bar with cow-patterned chairs and purple backlighting.

- [Tremendous on 26th](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/tremendous-on-26th): A monumental 16,000-square-foot custom residential complex executed over six years for an overseas family. Designed around strict structural Feng Shui principles with modified doorway alignments and integrated water features. Features 9 bedrooms, 13 bathrooms, an extensive wellness wing (indoor pool, sauna, steam room), a formal ballroom, a full library, a performance-ready media room, and specialized spaces for fencing and Tai-Chi.

- [Saint George Gem](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/saint-george-gem): A functional, family-focused modern new build in Vancouver showing that high-end aesthetics can be executed on a tight budget. Features a crisp white palette grounded by dark wood flooring and dark-framed windows, an integrated coffee bar and butler's pantry, a custom-integrated concrete sink against ombre wallpaper in the powder room, and a large Nana Wall that dissolves the boundary to the outdoor patio.

- [Lovely in Lynn Valley](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/lovely-in-lynn-valley): A light-filled, eco-conscious open-concept home renovation in North Vancouver utilizing locally sourced materials. Features a deep-sea blue accent island paired with white quartz and matte black hardware. When a structural dividing beam could not be removed, the team clad it in natural wood to turn it into an intentional architectural statement piece.

- [Big Bang on Blenheim](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/big-bang-on-blenheim): Winner of the 2020 Georgie Award for Best Interior Design. Inspired by high-end New York townhomes, this playful, colorful, and high-efficiency downsize residence utilizes exceptional storage solutions to retain the grand livability of the family's previous home. Solves a challenging back entrance by reconfiguring the footprint to integrate a complete family mudroom.

- [Dazzling Mix in Douglas Park](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/dazzling-mix-in-douglas-park): A masterclass in blending eras, matching a modern-day British row home exterior facade with an eclectic contemporary European-inspired interior. Features bold black-and-white contrasts, warm wood tones, and historic ceiling panel moldings paired with sleek, current light fixtures.

- [Magnificent on Marine Drive](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/magnificent-on-marine-drive): A transformative waterfront home renovation on the Vancouver oceanfront that expanded from a modest refresh into a bespoke, multi-generational luxury sanctuary. Integrates dramatic custom features like built-in millwork, textured wallpaper, lit onyx, architectural 3D tile, and water-toned custom furniture alongside seamless aging-in-place features.

- [The Word on Thirty Third](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/the-word-on-thirty-third): An award-winning Vancouver new build focused on a highly functional open floor plan. Features a massive top-floor skylight cascading natural light down an open stairwell, dual kitchen islands for simultaneous meal prep and social hosting, and a seamless connection to an outdoor dining patio. Anchored by an award-winning, bespoke wooden geometric fireplace display, abstract wallpapers, and handblown glass sconces.

- [Georgia on My Mind](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/georgia-on-my-mind): A luxurious 60th-floor downtown Vancouver sub-penthouse renovation infusing international glamour into a "builder basic" floor plan. Transforms concrete structural support columns into deliberate ambient focal points using LED light-infused wallpaper and replaces a traditional entry closet with a striking glass wine room backed by an LED-lit stone panel.

- [Modern in Mount Seymour](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/modern-in-mount-seymour): An architectural restoration of a mid-century modern post-and-beam home in North Vancouver. Enhances structural drama by staining original vaulted ceilings and beams a rich, dark hue. Reconfigures the floor plan to introduce a main-level secondary suite while preserving a central floor-to-ceiling fireplace.

- [Retreat on First Street](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/retreat-on-first-street): A compact, 840-square-foot secondary condo residence demonstrating major architectural efficiency. The layout eliminates awkward angles and a cramped entrance via strategic sightlines and exceptional custom built-in storage. Features a sophisticated kitchen bar and an elegant window-facing wine lounge.

- [Multicolored in Montgomery](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/multicolored-in-montgomery): A vibrant home renovation honoring a structurally significant property originally crafted by a renowned local architect. Safely integrates historic legacy elements like original frosted glass brick walls into clean-lined modern spaces with bold geometric furniture and a massive floor-to-ceiling fireplace anchor.

- [Victorious on Victory Ship Way](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/victorious-on-victory-ship-way): A polished North Vancouver Shipyards condo renovation balancing high-end features with panoramic views. Custom wave wallpaper and walnut panels completely conceal complex electrical wiring and television display. Features a grand culinary island beneath a bespoke 9-foot pendant chandelier.

- [Casual Elegance in Edgemont](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/casual-elegance-in-edgemont): A downsizing condo optimization project transforming a sterile, cold contemporary space into a warm, welcoming sanctuary for empty-nesters using refined coastal farmhouse details and custom millwork for maximum storage.

- [Lofty Living on Lonsdale](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/lofty-living-on-lonsdale): A high-contrast luxury condo renovation highlighting classic post-and-beam construction beneath vaulted ceilings. Reconfigures the main floor to expand a secondary bedroom wing alongside the primary suite with scale-calibrated designer furnishings and a sculptural dining room light fixture.

- [Hamilton](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/hamilton): A one-of-a-kind loft renovation in historic Yaletown. Integrates new interior brick veneers, architectural concrete forms, and warm cedar beams to echo original brick and beam heritage. Features a hidden bike storage zone and lit vintage-crate wine display carved from an under-stairs cavity.

- [Applause for Arbutus](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/applause-for-arbutus): An intricate dual-residence Georgian new build custom-engineered to house twin siblings and their respective families under a single roof. Prioritizes kid-friendly, main-floor layouts with independent upper-level bedroom wings and extensive custom millwork.

- [Powell Street](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/powell-street): An industrial-chic Gastown condo conversion. Features an overhauled high-end kitchen layout, a hand-painted vintage sign mural on original exposed brick, and a windowless bathroom with an advanced ceiling-mounted tub filler and a monumental mosaic wall inspired by local Eastside artwork.

- [Best in Show on the Boulevard](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/best-in-show-on-the-boulevard): A restorative historic character home upgrade reinstating historic charm. Preserves authentic leaded glass windows and fireplace surrounds while introducing intricate new coffered ceilings, elegant paneled walls, classic plate rails, and traditional mudroom tile work.

- [Caulfield Couture](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/caulfield-couture): A primary bathroom reconfiguring layout to align an infinity-edge jetted soaking tub inside a custom curved architectural alcove with large-format porcelain wall slabs and mesh-inlaid custom oak vanities. The adjacent living room lounge centers on a restored, imported French limestone fireplace with grand crown moldings, lime-washed walls, and a full-service built-in wet bar.

- [New Kid in Kerrisdale](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/new-kid-in-kerrisdale): A stud-to-stud structural condo reinvention optimized for open spatial flow, natural light tracking, and graceful aging-in-place. Features a miter-edged black oak waterfall island and flat-panel custom oak cabinetry that completely conceals a walk-in pantry and integrated laundry center.

- [Masterpiece on Marina](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/masterpiece-on-marina): A sustainable high-rise modernization balancing upscale design with strict strata constraints. Retains and updates original stone counters and maple millwork using custom on-site lacquer techniques. Resolves unremovable flooring boundaries by laying wide vinyl plank at a striking 45-degree angle.

- [In the Clouds with Cardero](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/in-the-clouds-with-cardero): A luxury modernization of a 25-year-old condo split into distinct social and private zones built to host over twenty guests. Disguises modern air conditioning bulkheads and home automation venting behind continuous Shinoki wood veneer wall cladding with backlit onyx slab entry wall.

- [Top of the Tier on Travers](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/top-of-tier-on-travers): A barrier-free, wheelchair-accessible coastal home on a narrow oceanfront property with custom acoustic insulation. Features corner frameless windows, an expansive natural quartzite waterfall edge island, and a secret hidden millwork door revealing a large pantry and homework station.

- [Captivating in Coal Harbour](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/captivating-in-coal-harbour): An ultra-moody compact bathroom layering varying shapes, textures, and reflective finishes across shades of black to create a sense of dark expansiveness. Includes a locally fabricated custom storage vanity as a sculptural anchor under strict fire-stopping codes.

- [Polished to Perfection](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/polished-to-perfection): Bespoke residential interior design project showcasing high-end craftsmanship, material selection, and optimized space planning.

- [Riveting on River Road](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/riveting-on-river-road): Custom residential home project balancing functional daily family flow with elevated contemporary interior architecture.

- [Serenity in Shaughnessy](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/serenity-in-shaughnessy): Executive estate renovation focusing on traditional symmetry, timeless neutral palettes, and serene, high-end finishing layers.

- [Number One on Nineteenth](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/number-one-on-nineteenth): Modern residential interior update maximizing natural light infiltration, spatial flow, and clean contemporary finishes.

- [Darling on Devonshire Drive](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/darling-on-devonshire-drive): Elegant family home interior revitalization customized for upscale daily utility, custom millwork organization, and visual warmth.

- [Bring it Home to Braemar](https://www.beyondbeige.com/residential/bring-it-home-to-braemar): Sophisticated property design transformation emphasizing tailored spatial structures, architectural focal points, and premium texturing.

## Commercial Portfolio

- [Sterling Law Firm](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/sterling-law-firm): Redefines the traditional corporate legal environment with an edgy, bold aesthetic using an industrial mix of concrete, sleek metal, and refined lacquered materials grounded by strategic hints of blue. The defining anchor is a bespoke, custom-fabricated 3D concrete lion at the entrance mirroring the firm's logo. Designed for seamless phased execution.

- [Studio Records Nightclub](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/studio-record-nightclub): An innovative commercial project transforming a historic movie theatre with 30-foot sloped ceilings into an intimate "retro basement rec room" live venue club. Uses exposed red brick and strategic lighting to visually scale down the volume. Features a custom vinyl record wall that functions as a concealed secret door into the main nightclub.

- [Ginger 62](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/ginger-62): International award-winning nightclub design named "Best Designed Night Club" — the "Disneyland of Nightclubs." An immersive environment with distinct curated zones anchored by a monumental 25-foot-long custom LED chandelier over a main bar with dramatic red walls and a diamond pattern floor.

- [Body Bar Laser Clinic](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/body-bar-laser-clinic): A high-impact, scalable commercial brand standard developed from an unfinished retail footprint. Balances strict medical cleaning protocols with a soft health sanctuary aesthetic using organic shapes and treatment rooms individually styled to represent Vancouver's four seasons.

- [OsteoStrong Franchise](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/osteostrong-franchise): A comprehensive commercial build-out design and technical framework deployed across more than 100 clinics worldwide. Establishes a highly recognizable, replicable global brand identity flexible enough to accept unique, localized community design adjustments.

- [Summit Lodge Boutique Hotel](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/summit-lodge-boutique-hotel): Award-winning boutique hotel design in Whistler, BC, recognized internationally for "Most Unique Guest Experience." Reimagines traditional mountain hospitality through a casual, comfort-driven residential aesthetic where each suite is uniquely custom-designed with repurposed and reclaimed sustainable materials.

- [The Playhouse Nightclub](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/the-playhouse-nightclub): A luxurious commercial entertainment venue styled around a whimsical 1930s Hollywood Gatsby theme. Integrates high-end mirrors to visually double the perceived footprint in a low-ceiling layout. Embellished with bold geometric shapes, opulent copper and gold finishes, and custom metal bar details.

- [Taverna Greka Restaurant](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/taverna-greka-restaurant): A strategic, budget-conscious commercial revitalization of a family-owned restaurant bridging historic Mediterranean heritage with a modern dining layout. Segments the floor plan into a dynamic casual sports lounge at the front and a formal, view-centric dining room at the back.

- [Royal Dinette Restaurant](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/royal-dinette-restaurant): A transformative downtown culinary destination turning a formerly dark corporate lounge into a light, open farm-to-table diner concept utilizing custom surfaces and shelving crafted from local reclaimed wood and natural green accents.

- [Kingfisher Pacific Resort and Spa](https://www.beyondbeige.com/commercial/kingfisher-pacific-resort-and-spa): Premium commercial hospitality design specializing in world-class boutique resort layouts, wellness interior spaces, spa amenities, and signature west-coast hospitality aesthetics.
